notes.title: Improvements & Fixes Update 9/8
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements & Fixes Update 9/8[/b]

- Fixed an issue where the Dyson Sphere (sphere itself, not the rings) doesn't visually show at all.
- Added a few missing translations.
- The Shelter and Waterwheel now tell you how to destroy structures to make sure players know about this even though it's already in the text on the tab menu.
- Fixed a rare issue where you'd place a colony hub flag near a specific tree and then when you teleport to it it'd put you mid air.
- Added a safety teleport back in the crashed aircraft temple for players who choose to go around and jump into the massive pit thinking that's where they have to go.
- Fixed water footstep sounds in a sand area in the dunes desert.
- Mechanical Steel Ingot has been added to the Industrial Furnace
- Changed Titanium Ingot icon so it's not the same as Mechanical Steel anymore.
- Fixed tamed dino never stops running away after it goes below 25% hp, even if it recovers it.
- Increased Coal Miner Colonist acceptence radius a bit to try to avoid an issue where it wouldn't be able to navigate correctly to the Coal Mine.

I'm really happy to see so many people enjoying the game, and especially [b]thanks to everyone who has been leaving a Steam review[/b], if you haven't yet [b]please help out with that so we can get more visibility on the game[/b].
Thank you so much!

notes.title: Improvements & Fixes Update 1/8
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements & Fixes Update 1/8[/b]

- Fixed a Dinosaur AI issue for medium/large dinosaurs where they would be stuck on slopes (issue caused by the previous update).
- Added a slight shooting cooldown to the bow to make it so you can't spam arrows too quickly.
- Fixed animals can spawn on top of caveman camps.
- Made the caveman camp spot that has a help marker always spawn the max number of caveman so you don't have a chance at not having enough bones for the time travel device upgrade.
- Fixed ocean ship blueprint re-appears once you come up to the Ice Age Era after already building the ship (which also indirectly caused the hot air balloon to stay in air if landed there).

I'm really happy to see so many people enjoying the game, and especially [b]thanks to everyone who has been leaving a Steam review[/b], if you haven't yet [b]please help out with that so we can get more visibility on the game[/b].
Thank you so much!

notes.title: Improvements & Fixes Update 31/7
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements & Fixes Update 31/7[/b]

- Fixed (mostly) an issue where medium/big dinosaurs would get jumped up into the air while fighting.
- Fixed cable connects to the Industrial Furnace way up in the air.
- Fixed an issue where you'd place the Claim Flag inside a house and it'd bug out the colonists.
- Added an additional warning when placing the Colony Hub to place it near water.
- Fixed an issue where you were able to build flying vehicles in the portal temple and it'd break the camera.
- You now don't lose your items if you die in the Futuristic Earth Era since it's just annoying if it happens.
- Made the AI integrate to the ship from farther away.
- Fixed an issue where the last tech tree is inaccessible after you complete every technology in the game.

I'm really happy to see so many people enjoying the game, and especially [b]thanks to everyone who has been leaving a Steam review[/b], if you haven't yet [b]please help out with that so we can get more visibility on the game[/b].
Thank you so much!

notes.title: France Alien Planet Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey, I had to do another hotfix for the alien planet, who knew alien AI could be this unpredictable...

[b]Alien Planet Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed an issue mostly affecting France users where the AI wouldn't integrate with the ship correctly.
- Fixed some see-through rocks along the path to the AI.
- Fixed Mouse Sensitivity cannot be changed while on Russian language.

I'm really happy to see so many people enjoying the game, and especially [b]thanks to everyone who has been leaving a Steam review[/b], if you haven't yet [b]please help out with that so we can get more visibility on the game[/b].
Thank you so much!

notes.title: Small Hotfix 28/7
notes.notes:
[b]Small Hotfix 28/7[/b]

- Fixed an issue for some players with exiting the alien planet.
- Made the tooltip text in the build menu (TAB) more visible (so players don't miss the info about how to destroy structures with X).
- Removed the random smoke coming out above beds lol.

I hope you are all enjoying the game,
Don't forget to leave a Steam review to help out,
Thanks.

notes.title: Highly wishlisted Steam survival game takes you from Ark to Starfield
notes.notes:
Grand Emprise certainly looks the part. "Time travel through history to become god," this absolutely ridiculous survival game boasts on its Steam store page. That's quite the pitch, but seeing it in action it's immediately clear how Grand Emprise has racked up over 140,000 wishlist additions on Steam. Blending the likes of Ark, Rust, and Sons of the Forest with the space adventuring of Astroneer and No Man's Sky, the Grand Emprise release date is just around the corner.
